subject: Re: Follow-up: Deployment mode & EU/APAC data residency (Hosted vs Private)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@northshorebank.com>
Cc: dev.patel@redwood.com, rachel.kim@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 14:12:00 -0400
Subject: Follow-up: Deployment mode & EU/APAC data residency

Hi Oliver —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we're aligned: 

Summary of requirements you mentioned:
- Primary requirement: All customer PII and transaction logs must remain in the EU for EU customers (data residency).
- Short term: EU-only residency for production traffic; APAC is a future region for onboarding a local cluster.
- Regulatory: Auditability and KMS integration are mandatory; SOC 2 evidence requested.
- Traffic pattern: Mostly low-latency API calls from web apps in EU, occasional cross-region failover for disaster recovery.

Initial deployment options we discussed:
- Hosted (Redwood API): fastest to prod, supports region routing but hosted EU region is required for strict EU residency.
- Dedicated (reserved capacity): predictable throughput + isolation; runs in your cloud region but still managed under Redwood tenancy.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): customer-managed network and full control over data plane; recommended if you must guarantee EU-only egress and separate key management.

Attachment: redwood-deployment-matrix.pdf (PDF, 120KB) — matrix comparing Hosted / Dedicated / Private for residency, SLA, cost, and ops overhead.

Proposed next steps:
1) Can you confirm whether NorthShore needs EU-only egress for ALL logs/metrics, or if pseudonymized logs can leave the region?
2) If EU-only is required, would you be open to a Private VPC pilot (60d) vs Dedicated in an EU-only account?
3) I'll loop in our solutions engineer (Dev) for a technical deep-dive to validate network/KMS requirements.

If that sounds right I'll schedule the technical follow-up for later this week.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@northshorebank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: security@northshorebank.com
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 19:37:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Deployment mode & EU/APAC data residency

Thanks Marissa — very helpful summary. A few clarifications from my side (security & infra):

- EU-only: Yes — all customer-identifiable data and full request/response payloads must remain in the EU for production. Pseudonymized metrics may be aggregated outside but raw logs must not.
- KMS: We need CMK integration with our Azure Key Vault (customer-managed keys). Any solution must support an HSM-backed key and customer-controlled rotation.
- APAC: We'll want a local APAC region later in the year, but initial go-live needs to be EU-only. Cross-region routing for failover is acceptable only if data residency guarantees are met (i.e., no EU customer traffic routed to APAC).

We've attached our high-level security questions to this reply. Please have your security & SRE teams review.

Attachment: nsb-security-questions.pdf (PDF, 85KB)

For next steps: we're inclined toward Private VPC if that gives us the explicit data residency and KM controls. However, open to discussing Dedicated if it can be scoped to an EU-only tenancy and support our KMS requirements. Let's do the technical deep-dive.

—Oliver
Oliver Grant
Head of Cloud Security, NorthShore Bank
oliver.grant@northshorebank.com | +44 20 7946 0114

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@northshorebank.com>
Cc: dev.patel@redwood.com, rachel.kim@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 08:15:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Deployment mode & EU/APAC data residency

Appreciate the clarity, Oliver — this helps a lot. Quick responses inline: 

- EU-only: Understood. Private VPC will provide the clearest guarantee (customer-managed networks + no cross-region egress). Dedicated can be scoped to a single EU tenancy but we'll need network controls and contractual commitments around egress to ensure logs never leave the EU.
- KMS: We support customer-managed keys (CMKs) and HSM-backed KMS integrations. I've flagged the security questions to our Security and SRE teams; Dev will lead the technical answers in the deep-dive.
- APAC: We can plan a staged approach — EU-only pilot (Private or Dedicated) for go-live, then add an APAC deployment later with explicit routing policies so EU traffic never fails over to APAC.

Proposed next steps / schedule:
1) Technical deep-dive with Dev (30-45m) — propose Tue 25 Aug 2026 14:00 BST / 09:00 ET.
2) Security review: Redwood to provide SOC2 evidence + KMS integration doc (I'll share links).
3) Pilot decision: If SRE/security confirms, we'll scope a 60-day Private VPC pilot and provide a proposal (timeline + estimated cost).

Related: https://hubspot.com/deals/NSB-2026-1123 — I've attached the deployment matrix again for reference.

Let me know if the proposed time works and I'll send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Marissa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@northshorebank.com>
Cc: rachel.kim@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:03:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Deployment mode & EU/APAC data residency — technical deep-dive

Hi all — happy to join the deep-dive. A few quick technical notes to help you prep: 

- Private VPC (recommended for strict EU residency): we'll provision a customer VPC in your Azure subscription (or equivalent), deploy the Redwood control plane in our managed control plane (optionally isolated) and the data plane within your tenancy — ensures no data egress.
- KMS: we support Azure Key Vault with HSM-backed keys and customer rotation. We'll need a service principal and RBAC controls documented ahead of time.
- Network requirements: outbound NAT rules, egress allow-list, and optional private endpoint / peering. I've attached our network requirements doc.
- Cross-region routing: we can implement region-aware routing policies so EU requests failover to a staging EU replica, never to APAC. APAC deployments will be separate clusters with explicit routing controls.

Attachment: redwood-network-requirements.md (Markdown, 6KB)

I'll send a calendar invite for Tue 25 Aug 14:00 BST (09:00 ET) — please confirm availability. I'll prepare a short deck showing the Private VPC architecture and the Dedicated configuration for comparison.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.com
